scope: Supplementary availability and plan-reading control under AMENDMENT-01; selected from source-labelled First Street next to Block 5
prior_exposure: All five plan panels inspected before this inventory; earlier text-based expectations known. Freeze precedes numerical width calculation, not source selection.
parent_source: Mackay, Further Excavations at Mohenjo-daro, Volume II, plates XVI–XX; held scan title page prints 1937, customary reference 1938
north_reference: N arrow on source; true/grid/magnetic type unspecified
measure: A local clear width of the source-labelled First Street opposite the middle frontage of Block 5 in each plan. Not the identical geodetic transect across panels.
selection: One source-labelled frontage per panel; no measurement chosen by result. Record a failed reading if banks or scale cannot be identified.
scale_bar_reading: Printed 0 to 50 FEET; exact conversion convention 0.3048 m/ft; historical foot realization unspecified
digitization: Source-bank endpoints visually checked; inspect luminance profile across fixed transect and neighboring rows. Endpoint radial sensitivity 5 px; bar endpoint sensitivity 3 px. Preserve alternative readings.
registration: None: local widths use each panel own bar. Independent cross-panel survey-grid origin not adjudicated.
p1_missing_reasons: No independently audited common window registration
